entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I think I need to return something. I'm just a bit lost with the website and the rules. It's all very overwhelming.
Of course, I can help you with that. Can you tell me which item you're calling about?
It's the VeloFit cycling shoes I bought. I've tried them a few times, but they just hurt my feet so much.
I'm sorry to hear they aren't working out for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

Oh, um, a fit issue, I guess? They gave me terrible blisters. And I don't know if I attached the cleats correctly. I just couldn't figure it out. Can't you just help me? I just want to send them back.
I completely understand. Getting blisters is no fun and definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order details. Can you provide me with your order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. The cycling shoes were delivered 35 days ago. Let me just check the policy.
Alright, good news. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? So you can just... take them back? That's such a relief. I was so worried I was stuck with them.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed.
Wow, that's perfect. Thank you so much for making that so easy, Alex.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
